headline: Healthcare Global Enterprises Limited: General Updates

detail: General Updates — The Board of Directors of the Company has, at their meeting held today, i.e., May 19, 2026, approved the divestment by way of sale of HealthCare Global Enterprises Limited s ( the Company ) entire equity shareholding in BACC Health Care Private Limited ( BACC ) to Inviga Healthcare Fund I and its nominee ( Buyer ), for a consideration of INR 37,64,44,788 (Indian Rupees Thirty Seven Crores Sixty Four Lakhs Forty Four Thousand Seven Hundred and Eighty Eight Only), on the terms agreed under a Share Purchase Agreement ( SPA ) to be entered into amongst the Company, BACC and the Buyer (the  Proposed Transaction ).
